newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 18.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 18.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, Wall Street was closed due to a holiday.

* On Friday, the Dow Jones industrial average fell as Wall Street took a breather a day after the blue-chip index closed above 7,000 points for the first time. It fell 33.48 points to 6,988.96 while the broader market ended mixed.
* Media reports that the health of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping was deteriorating were also seen dampening sentiment, brokers said.

* Tambang Timah on continued speculation about its involvement in the Busang gold project after Monday's announcement by Bre-X Minerals Ltd that the firm and its Indonesian partners had formed a joint venture with Freeport McMoRan Copper and Gold Inc to develop the property.
* Anwar Sierad after its announcement of a stock split and change of its board of directors which is subject to shareholders approval at a meeting on February 28.
* Bank Mashill Utama on the announcement of its proposal for a rights issue and stock split.
* Telecommunications service provider PT Indosat on news it was eyeing a stake in a reservation service company PT Abacus Indonesia, which is part owned by national flag carrier Garuda Indonesia.
* Lippo Group companies following news the group was keen to take a 38-percent stake in foodmaker Auric Pacific.
* Bank Danamon on market talk of its possible acquisition of the privately-owned Bank Pacific.

* Toll road builder and operator Citra Marga on a local newspaper report which quoted sources at the capital markets watchdog Bapepam that the firm planned to add 25 billion rupiah to an earlier proposal to issue bonds worth 250 billion rupiah. The bond issue would total 275 billion rupiah.
